_comment: Curated, user-facing release highlights for the in-app 'What's New' popup and the changelog page's highlights column. Keyed by version (no leading v). Newest entries are shown first; the popup surfaces every entry newer than the user's last-seen version. Tone mirrors the Discord patch notes: short, friendly, one line per highlight. Maintain alongside each release (see the release checklist in .kiro/steering/dev-agent.md). Keep the raw per-session technical detail in docs/changelog.md; this file is the curated highlights only.

versions.title: More accurate fielding valuation
highlights: Defensive value is now measured against the players who actually man each position, so a league-average glove grades as average instead of everyone looking above-average.
Third basemen are no longer capped: a genuinely good defender at the hot corner now stands out from an average one.
Elite defenders still shine and weak gloves now correctly grade below average — the full range is back.
Pitchers and hitting are unaffected; this is a fielding-only refinement.

versions.title: Spring Training Opening Day builder
highlights: New Spring Training page: build and stress-test your Opening Day 26-man and see the projected record respond live.
Projected lineups vs RHP and vs LHP — a real 1-9 batting order (on-base leads off, best hitter 2nd, power at cleanup), with Modern/Traditional and on-base/speed leadoff preferences.
The roster recommender now auto-platoons: a lefty bat weak vs LHP is correctly benched against lefties.
Pitching staff fixed: a full 8-man bullpen, an 'add arm' control, realistic per-league innings, and relievers valued in a relief role rather than as starters.
Handedness at a glance: RHP/LHP badges on pitchers, L/R/S badges on hitters, and a warning when the bullpen has no left-hander.
More accurate player valuation: value is now built up from hitting, baserunning, fielding, and position in run-space, fixing cases where an out-of-position bat was undervalued.
Pitcher evaluation no longer over-trusts a small sample of recent results over a pitcher's established talent.

versions.title: Stability fix
highlights: Internal test-reliability fix — no change to the app itself.

versions.title: Faster, more reliable refreshes
highlights: Refreshes no longer hang silently on a stalled request — every pull is now time-bounded and retried.
Large-league and offseason refreshes are quicker: redundant data renders are cached and skipped.
A per-league lock prevents overlapping refreshes from stacking up on the same league.

versions.title: Hitter evaluation fixes & league analytics
highlights: Hitter grades re-centered on offense — weak-hitting catchers no longer float up and strong-hitting center fielders no longer sink.
Prospect value now keeps a player's already-developed ability as a floor instead of discounting the whole projection.
New player-page positional bell curve shows where a player ranks among his position's peers.
The league Advanced-stats tab adds single-stat distributions and customizable scatter views.
